title: Native Conflicting Authority Representation
purpose: Determine whether the V05 successor can natively represent conflicting authentic authority observations, preserve those observations, explicitly classify present authority as conflicted, and withhold consequence.

adversarial_condition.observation_a: Authentic ACTIVE AuthorityState with SEND at epoch 1
adversarial_condition.observation_b: Authentic REVOKED successor AuthorityState at epoch 2
adversarial_condition.current_standing: Not established because authentic authority observations disagree

required_discriminators: Both authentic authority observations remain preserved
Witness conflict record retains both observation hashes
bounded_claim: Success establishes only native conflict representation and consequence containment in this deterministic local test. It does not establish distributed-consensus correctness, production authority provenance, or real network split-brain resolution.
